notes_for_editor: Conflict left open: Tennessee Landforms says historical (undated); the NRHP multiple property form lists DeLong as extant as of March 26, 2014. The form gives names and counties only, with no build year, design or site description for DeLong. A check of current Hamilton County or TDF records would settle whether the tower stood after 2014. Tennessee Landforms per-tower pages (m.php) carry injected gambling-site text and were not used. Web searches found no separate DeLong tower record. The brief status of unknown is not an error, so no correction is proposed.
